info.description: Delivery CI runs, records, and pipeline status. Consumers call it through the generated clients in clients/go and clients/ts.
info.title: Putnami Delivery API

post.description: Assign the next CI job to a reused machine. A separate host-purpose credential alias authenticates the original machine run and workspace; the job's ordinary ingest token and replay ingest aliases are refused. The completed run is checked by the assignment owner. Returns a bounded Docker env file in env, or an empty env when no job is assigned.

401.description: Run credential missing, invalid or expired

403.description: Host-purpose alias required, or machine or workspace differs from the credential

post.description: Submit a delivery run record. With a run credential (the orchestrated runner or a dispatched worker) the body drives the run's lifecycle: the first contact moves queued to in_progress, a terminal status posts the conclusion, and a terminal submission may carry operational metrics, the published digest set, the impacted projects and a failure attribution; replays are 200 no-ops. The workspace and run come out of the credential; body workspace, repo, sha and submissionId are accepted only as consistency assertions. A workspace bearer submits a claimed local run instead.

400.description: Invalid body, status, conclusion, metrics or an assertion that contradicts the credential's run

401.description: Run credential missing, invalid or expired

403.description: The body asserts a workspace or submission the credential is not scoped to

post.description: Mint the run's cache lease: a cache token whose object writer is limited to default-branch runs. Authenticated by the run credential alone; the body is exactly {}. Refusals carry {error, message, code}; a provider passes the code on and retries only 408, 429 and 5xx.

204.description: The run has no run-scoped cache lease

400.description: The body is not exactly {}, or the run's authority cannot be derived

401.description: Run credential missing, invalid or expired

409.description: The run is terminal or its authority drifted

502.description: The cache lease could not be minted, or was minted outside its bounds

503.description: The cache capability is not configured or not available now

post.description: Mint the run's install credential: one short Distribution bearer that reads exactly the installable members of the release set the run's workspace follows. Authenticated by the run credential alone; the body is exactly {}. Refusals carry {error, message, code}; a provider passes the code on and retries only 408, 429 and 5xx.

204.description: The run needs no install credential

400.description: The body is not exactly {}, or the run's authority cannot be derived

401.description: Run credential missing, invalid or expired

403.description: Identity denied the install delegation

409.description: The run is terminal, its authority drifted, or the release track is ambiguous or no longer authorized

422.description: The release set needs more read scopes than one bearer carries

502.description: Identity or Distribution failed, or answered outside the contract

503.description: The install capability is not configured or not available now

post.description: Answer whether the run may move its forward-only channels now: false only for a default-branch run whose commit is no longer the head of that branch. Mints nothing and moves nothing. Authenticated by the run credential alone; the body is exactly {}.

401.description: Run credential missing, invalid or expired

503.description: Native publication is not configured, or the default branch head cannot be read

post.description: Answer the run's native publication authority (namespace, channels, and the forward-only channels of a default-branch run) with one read-only release-set bearer. Authenticated by the run credential alone; the body is exactly {}.

201.description: The planning authority and its bearer

400.description: The body is not exactly {}, or the run has no publication authority

401.description: Run credential missing, invalid or expired

409.description: The run is terminal, or its capability drifted

502.description: Identity failed to mint the capability, or answered outside the contract

503.description: Native publication is not configured, or the default branch head cannot be read

post.description: Freeze the publication plan's digest on the run and answer one short bearer for only that plan's package and channel authority. Posting the same plan again mints another bearer. Authenticated by the run credential alone.

400.description: The plan does not match the run's publication authority, or its digest is invalid

401.description: Run credential missing, invalid or expired

409.description: Another plan is frozen on the run, or the run is terminal

502.description: Identity failed to mint the capability, or answered outside the contract

post.description: Submit a parsed report batch (tests, coverage, builds, selection) for an existing run. Idempotent per submission id and report kind; the workspace comes out of the credential, and a body workspace is accepted only as a consistency assertion.

400.description: Invalid body, or a batch with no report

403.description: The body asserts a workspace or submission the credential is not scoped to

404.description: No run for the submission id

post.description:
Run one safe, idempotent CI recovery pass within the path workspace: stale queued/in-progress runs become errored/timed_out, persisted compute is canceled, abandoned phases become timed_out, and existing terminal aggregate/phase checks are reconciled. Never fabricates success and never redispatches accepted work. The historical check scan is bounded and reports scanLowerBound when capped. Requires delivery.run.manage; workspace machine tokens are denied.

Required scopes: delivery.run.manage.

403.description: Manage permission required, workspace mismatch, or machine token denied

503.description: A service Delivery depends on failed. The body names it (code delivery.dependency_unavailable, dependency, details.dependency) and its sentence says whether a retry can help

get.description:
Aggregated CI status and readiness for a workspace: pipeline breaker mode, delivery.ci config/preview readiness, runner-image freshness on the dispatch axis that actually runs, the effective release the last run recorded (image digest + Putnami CLI version), and a queue/stuck scan of the workspace's open runs — each as a dimension carrying a first-class state and exactly one recovery action. A dimension whose facts are missing reports provenance-unknown, never healthy. Operators (platform.operator.act) additionally see the GitHub ruleset-enforcement drift, the App check-publish permission dimension, and the durable check-publication backlog. Requires delivery.run.read at the path workspace; workspace machine tokens remain denied.

Required scopes: delivery.run.read.

403.description: Workspace read permission required, workspace mismatch, or machine token denied

503.description: CI status facts source is not configured on this host

get.description:
Read the workspace-owned operational CI subscription. Commercial contract state remains in Business. Responses are not cacheable.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.read.

403.description: Workspace permission or producer access grant required

503.description: Live subscription or Distribution authority unavailable

put.description:
Create or replace the workspace-owned operational CI subscription with revision CAS. Producer workspace IDs are resolved server-side from live Distribution bindings and access grants.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.manage.

403.description: Workspace permission or producer access grant required

503.description: Live subscription or Distribution authority unavailable

post.description:
Disable the operational CI subscription while preserving its settings, using revision CAS.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.manage.

403.description: Workspace permission or producer access grant required

503.description: Live subscription or Distribution authority unavailable

get.description:
Aggregate a workspace's CI runs over a reporting window (default 7d, `window` a Go duration) into counts by substrate outcome, profile, and resolution source, a gate wall-time summary per substrate, a terminal-outcome taxonomy, and an estimated spend. Requires delivery.run.read at the path workspace; workspace machine tokens remain denied.

Required scopes: delivery.run.read.

403.description: Workspace read permission required, workspace mismatch, or machine token denied

post.description:
Set the workspace CI circuit-breaker mode: pause (paused — no new compute), drain (draining — no new compute, in-flight settles), or resume (active). A pause may request cancelRunning to also cancel the workspace's already-running runs. Records the actor + reason as a durable audit row. Requires delivery.run.manage at the path workspace; workspace machine tokens are denied.

Required scopes: delivery.run.manage.

403.description: Manage permission required, workspace mismatch, or machine token denied

get.description:
List a workspace's CI runs newest-first with offset pagination and immutable subject references, optionally filtered by repository, branch, ref (a commit SHA prefix or a branch name), pull request, status or conclusion, phase, creation time and run id prefix. A filtered page carries a filter member naming the filters it applied; the caller applies any other one itself. Requires delivery.run.read at the path workspace; workspace machine tokens remain denied.

Required scopes: delivery.run.read.

403.description: Workspace read permission required, workspace mismatch, or machine token denied

post.description:
Manually start a CI run for an explicit pushed SHA on a repository bound to the workspace. The SHA is validated server-side as a known pushed commit on a bound repo (an unpushed or foreign SHA is rejected). Opens a run at attempt 1 with an optional safe phase selection, an optional allocation-v2 runner profile (size omitted or auto selects automatically; physical sizes are xsmall, small, standard, large, and xlarge), an optional per-run gate fan-out (maxParallel, 1..32), and an optional noCache that forces the gate to execute every planned task rather than reuse cache entries (recorded in provenance; it never widens the gate's impacted selection). Requires delivery.run.manage at the path workspace; workspace machine tokens are denied.

Required scopes: delivery.run.manage.

202.description: Run opened; the network tail (queued check + Job start) proceeds asynchronously.

403.description: Manage permission required, workspace mismatch, or machine token denied

404.description: The SHA is not a known pushed commit on a repository bound to this workspace

409.description: No run opened — the pipeline is paused or the change was gated

412.description: The request cannot open a run and no retry of it will: the trusted putnami.ci.json declares something this Delivery cannot read, the request names no branch, the sha is not the current head of the branch or pull request, or the trusted revision has no putnami.ci.json

503.description: A service Delivery depends on failed. The body names it (code delivery.dependency_unavailable, dependency, details.dependency) and its sentence says whether a retry can help

get.description:
Get one workspace CI run with its immutable subject reference and per-phase attempts. With detail=true it also carries each failed task's error, diagnostics and last output lines from the derived failure digest, and, on a finished run, the session record's delivery account. Requires delivery.run.read at the path workspace; a run from another workspace remains not found and workspace machine tokens remain denied.

Required scopes: delivery.run.read.

403.description: Workspace read permission required, workspace mismatch, or machine token denied

404.description: Run not found in the workspace

post.description:
Idempotently cancel a CI run: cancel its compute and transition it to canceled under the run CAS so a late runner conclusion loses (terminal truth wins). Re-cancel and cancel-after-conclusion are 200 no-ops. Requires delivery.run.manage at the path workspace; a run from another workspace is not found and workspace machine tokens are denied.

Required scopes: delivery.run.manage.

403.description: Manage permission required, workspace mismatch, or machine token denied

404.description: Run not found in the workspace

503.description: A service Delivery depends on failed. The body names it (code delivery.dependency_unavailable, dependency, details.dependency) and its sentence says whether a retry can help

get.description:
Get one workspace CI run's contracted Putnami gate report. Requires delivery.run.read at the path workspace; missing report data remains not found rather than an all-zero projection.

Required scopes: delivery.run.read.

403.description: Workspace read permission required, workspace mismatch, or machine token denied

404.description: Run or gate report not found in the workspace

get.description:
Get one workspace CI run's derived results: the test cases of each test task (failed first), the coverage of each task with its enforced threshold, the diagnostics of each task by file and line, and the artifacts the run published. Requires delivery.run.read at the path workspace; a run whose session stream was not received remains not found rather than an empty document.

Required scopes: delivery.run.read.

403.description: Workspace read permission required, workspace mismatch, or machine token denied

404.description: Run or results not found in the workspace

get.description:
Get one workspace CI run's derived per-task timing table — absolute start, end and CPU share per task, longest wall first — so a run's critical path can be reconstructed. Requires delivery.run.read at the path workspace; missing timing data remains not found rather than an empty table.

Required scopes: delivery.run.read.

403.description: Workspace read permission required, workspace mismatch, or machine token denied

404.description: Run or timing table not found in the workspace

get.description:
Read a bounded, cursor-paginated, redacted page of ONE CI run execution's logs, filtered server-side by phase, project, level, q text search, and time window, with actionable diagnostics + a copyable local reproduction command. Requires delivery.run.read at the target workspace; machine tokens are denied.

Required scopes: delivery.run.read.

400.description: Invalid selector (bad timestamp, level, q, or limit)

403.description: Insufficient permissions, machine token, or workspace mismatch

404.description: Run not found in this workspace, or no execution logs recorded yet

503.description: CI run logs not available on this deployment, or the log store did not answer: the body then names it (code delivery.dependency_unavailable, dependency Cloud Logging or Cloud Storage)

get.description:
Stream newly-arrived redacted log entries for one CI run execution over SSE with an opaque resume cursor. Requires delivery.run.read at the target workspace; machine tokens are denied.

Stream endpoint (WebSocket, SSE). Connect via WebSocket upgrade or Accept: text/event-stream.

Required scopes: delivery.run.read.

400.description: Invalid selector (bad timestamp, level, q, or limit)

403.description: Insufficient permissions, machine token, or workspace mismatch

404.description: Run not found in this workspace, or no execution logs recorded yet

503.description: CI run logs not available on this deployment, or the log store did not answer: the body then names it (code delivery.dependency_unavailable, dependency Cloud Logging or Cloud Storage)

post.description:
Retry a CI run as a new attempt of the same SHA/workflow snapshot: the whole run, or a single failed phase plus its invalidated dependents (phase ∪ dependents). Optional size (omitted or auto selects automatically; physical sizes are xsmall, small, standard, large, and xlarge) and maxParallel (1..32) fields override the runner profile and gate fan-out for the new attempt. An optional noCache requests an explicit clean, cache-busting run: the gate executes every planned task instead of reusing local or remote cache entries, and the request is recorded in provenance; otherwise the retry respects the run's content-addressed cache and publish state. It never widens the gate's impacted selection. Requires delivery.run.manage at the path workspace; a run from another workspace is not found and workspace machine tokens are denied.

Required scopes: delivery.run.manage.

202.description: New attempt opened; the network tail proceeds asynchronously.

403.description: Manage permission required, workspace mismatch, or machine token denied

404.description: Run not found in the workspace

409.description: No run opened — the pipeline is paused or the change was gated

412.description: The request cannot open a run and no retry of it will: no free run attempt id, an unreadable trusted putnami.ci.json, a retired acceptance run, a sha that is no longer the head of its branch or pull request, or a trusted revision with no putnami.ci.json

503.description: A service Delivery depends on failed. The body names it (code delivery.dependency_unavailable, dependency, details.dependency) and its sentence says whether a retry can help
